entries: Michael's main safehouse is the De Santa Residence in Rockford Hills. It provides a bed for saving, wardrobe access, a garage, television, computer access, and family-related activities as the story develops.
Franklin begins with the Clinton Residence in Strawberry, where he lives with his aunt Denise. It provides normal safehouse functions and a place to store his personal Buffalo S nearby.
Franklin later receives 3671 Whispymound Drive in Vinewood Hills after The Hotel Assassination. It becomes his upgraded main residence and includes a larger garage.
Trevor's Trailer in Sandy Shores is his original main safehouse and reflects his Blaine County lifestyle. It provides normal save and wardrobe functions.
Trevor temporarily uses Floyd's Vespucci apartment after reaching Los Santos. It serves as a temporary base during the middle of Trevor's city storyline.
After Hang Ten, Trevor takes control of the Vanilla Unicorn and uses it as a later Story Mode base in Los Santos.
what can you do in safehouse gta v

Safehouses generally provide a bed for saving, wardrobe access, health recovery items, television or computer access where available, and nearby personal-vehicle storage. Sleeping advances in-game time by a character-specific amount.
how garage storage works gta v story
Story Mode garages can store personal vehicles, but they are not GTA Online's insured garage system. A destroyed stored car can still be lost, so unique vehicles should be handled carefully.

Ammu-Nation is GTA V's main weapons retailer. As story progress unlocks inventory, the stores sell firearms, ammunition, body armor, attachments, and weapon tints. Some locations include shooting ranges.
Selected Ammu-Nation stores include shooting ranges. Completing range challenges improves Shooting skill and can unlock store discounts while also contributing to the 100% activity checklist.
Los Santos Customs gta v story

Los Santos Customs repairs and modifies vehicles in Story Mode. Available upgrades include performance parts, armor, brakes, engine, transmission, turbo where supported, wheels, paint, body parts, and bulletproof tires.
Ponsonbys is the premium clothing chain in Los Santos, selling formal and high-end outfits, suits, shoes, and accessories.
Suburban is a mid-range clothing chain offering casual and fashionable clothing for the protagonists.
Binco is a lower-cost clothing retailer with casual outfits and everyday clothing choices.
Discount Store outlets sell inexpensive casual clothing and are among the lower-cost wardrobe options in Story Mode.
Barber shops let protagonists change hairstyles and facial hair where applicable. Available styles vary by protagonist and story/content version.
Tattoo parlors let protagonists apply or remove tattoos. Available designs vary by body area, protagonist, and installed content.
Convenience stores such as 24/7 and LTD sell small consumable items and can be robbed in free roam. Robbing a store normally attracts police attention.
Car washes remove dirt from ordinary vehicles for a small fee. They are a cosmetic service and do not repair mechanical damage.
what happens when you die gta v story
When a protagonist is wasted in free roam, they normally respawn at a hospital and lose a portion of cash. Mission failure instead follows that mission's checkpoint and retry rules.

Taxis can carry a protagonist to map destinations. The ride can usually be skipped for faster travel, and Franklin can also perform taxi work and special Private Fares after acquiring Downtown Cab Co.
Los Santos Transit metro gta v
Los Santos has a metro/subway network with stations around the city. Trains run through the system as ambient public transport and can be ridden or explored in free roam.

Freight trains continuously travel along San Andreas rail routes. They are generally not controllable by the player in normal Story Mode, but they can be boarded and are used in missions such as Derailed.
Mount Chiliad cable car gta v
The Mount Chiliad Aerial Tramway connects the lower station near Paleto Forest to the summit area, providing a scenic route up the mountain.
Protagonists can visit cinemas and watch in-game films. Some cinemas can also be purchased as Story Mode properties by eligible characters.
The in-game internet can be accessed through smartphones and some computers. It is used for vehicle purchases, property information, stock markets, entertainment sites, and story-related browsing.
Each protagonist has a smartphone used for calls, texts, email, internet access, Quick Save, contacts, and mission-related communication.
Los Santos Rock Radio gta v
Los Santos Rock Radio focuses on classic rock and is hosted by Kenny Loggins. It is available as a vehicle radio station in Story Mode.
Radio Los Santos focuses on contemporary Los Santos hip-hop and rap and is one of the core urban music stations.
West Coast Classics plays classic West Coast hip-hop and is hosted by DJ Pooh.
Non Stop Pop FM gta v
Non-Stop-Pop FM plays pop, dance-pop, and related mainstream music and is hosted by Cara Delevingne.
Rebel Radio plays country and outlaw-country music and fits the rural Blaine County setting.
Channel X is the punk and hardcore station, hosted by Keith Morris.
Vinewood Boulevard Radio focuses on indie and alternative rock and is hosted by members of Wavves.
FlyLo FM focuses on experimental electronic, beat, and psychedelic music and is hosted by Flying Lotus.
The Lowdown 91.1 plays classic soul and funk and is hosted by Pam Grier.
Soulwax FM is an electronic and dance station curated by Soulwax.
East Los FM focuses on Latin music styles associated with Los Santos' Hispanic communities.
Blaine County Radio is a rural talk-radio station heard mainly in Blaine County, featuring fictional local programming rather than a music playlist.
Space 103.2 plays funk and related music and is hosted by Bootsy Collins.
West Coast Talk Radio gta v
West Coast Talk Radio, or WCTR, is Los Santos-focused talk radio with satirical shows and fictional hosts.
Worldwide FM plays a broad mixture of world, electronic, jazz, and alternative music curated by Gilles Peterson.
Radio Mirror Park focuses on indie, synth-pop, and electronic music and is hosted by Twin Shadow.
The Blue Ark is a reggae and dub station hosted by Lee 'Scratch' Perry.
Self Radio is a PC feature that plays music files placed in the game's User Music folder after the game scans them. It is not available on console versions in the same form.
The Lab is a radio station added in later versions of GTA V, featuring original tracks connected to The Alchemist and Oh No. Availability depends on platform/version.
While in a compatible vehicle, the radio wheel lets the player switch among available stations or turn the radio off. Station availability can vary by platform and game version.
talk radio changes county gta v
GTA V's talk-radio presentation is region-aware: WCTR is associated with Los Santos while Blaine County Radio serves the rural county, reinforcing the difference between city and countryside.
radio stations different versions gta v
The radio lineup and song catalog changed across GTA V editions and updates. Franklin should avoid claiming that every later-added station or track exists on the original PS3/Xbox 360 release.
The vehicle radio can be turned off from the radio wheel. Overall music and audio levels can also be adjusted in the game's audio settings.
